supersededPresentationAssertions.formerBehavior: An unfiltered and unsorted /collections/all request substitutes the 150-item text directory.
supersededPresentationAssertions.successor: The native photographic Product grid is the default /collections/all presentation.

supersededPresentationAssertions.formerBehavior: A sort_by query exposes the photographic grid and therefore doubles as a view switch.
supersededPresentationAssertions.successor: sort_by controls ordering only and never selects the directory.

supersededPresentationAssertions.formerBehavior: The canonical catalog page uses the text directory's 150-item page size.
supersededPresentationAssertions.successor: The default catalog uses its configured native 20-Product page; the 150-item directory pager exists only in collection.directory.

supersededPresentationAssertions.formerBehavior: The default catalog omits Product cards, images, prices, and purchase controls.
supersededPresentationAssertions.successor: The default catalog retains native cards, images or text fallback, prices, availability, and bulk quick-add.

supersededPresentationAssertions.formerBehavior: The duplicate-suppressed theme child is labeled Parts and supplies.
supersededPresentationAssertions.successor: The explicit photographic catalog child is labeled All Products.

retainedAuthorityAssertions: Product roles and compatibility are consumed only from existing Epic E/F/G authority and are never inferred from navigation, titles, tags, prices, or collection nesting.
The directory uses one native pager, fails closed when authority is expired or drifted, and retains neutral Product browsing.
Historical G3A machine route semantics, Product identities, fragments, and omission reasons remain sealed and are not renewed by this successor.
Missing aggregate collection handles remain suppressed; directory anchors are not Shopify collection identities.
No source receipt, Product classification, compatibility edge, collection membership, or publication state is created by this binding.

authority.previewImplication: Photographic catalog and cart testing may proceed after authorization, but current governed role and machine-context claims require a fresh authorized source reconciliation.
